context: Most frequent rifampicin-resistance substitution in the rpoB RRDR; high-level resistance. Rifamycins bind RpoB directly, so mutant-vs-wildtype binding delta is the correct signal.
notes: AMR positive control. S450L confers high-level resistance across the rifamycin class (largest reported odds ratio for rifampicin resistance). The off-target drugs must come back UNCHANGED - they bind other proteins entirely, so any predicted shift is pipeline noise.
